_about: Hand edits to auto-generated names in the per-ability taxonomy. Keys: leaves by their full signature string (as shown with ?dev=1), nodes by 'family|effect type|zone from|zone to|counter type|player scope|granted modifications', families by their internal key. Value: {"name": "...", "coined": false, "basis": "where the term comes from", "note": "..."}. src/build_ability_taxonomy.py applies every key that still exists and reports the rest as orphaned instead of dropping them.

fam=Zone change · ftype=ChangeZone · frm.name: Alternative cost: exile a card from your hand rather than pay the mana cost
fam=Zone change · ftype=ChangeZone · frm.basis: 'Alternative cost' is the Comprehensive Rules term (118.9); the group is the pitch-spell cost (Force of Will and its relatives), not an exile effect.
fam=Zone change · ftype=ChangeZone · frm.note: All 21 members with text read 'You may exile ... card(s) from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost'; the parse stores it as an ordinary optional exile item, so the signature cannot say it. Hand-written because no field in the signature carries 'alternative cost'.

fam=Life · ftype=GainLife · who=controll.name: Gain life, or give a creature lifelink, until end of turn
fam=Life · ftype=GainLife · who=controll.basis: Plain wording; 'lifelink' is a keyword (CR 702.15). The group is a mix, so the name states both.
fam=Life · ftype=GainLife · who=controll.note: 10 members: 7 'you gain N life' and 3 'target creature gains your choice of lifelink or ... until end of turn'. The parse files both under GainLife with a duration, so no signature field separates them.
